description: Analyze the SMTP capture file (smtp.pcap) to identify the Client IP (sending HELO/EHLO) and Server IP (sending 220 greeting). Configure Wireshark's Name Resolution (e.g., via the 'hosts' file) to map the Client IP to 'Infected_Client' and the Server IP to 'Corporate_Mail_Server'. Enable name resolution in the view. Finally, export the first 20 packets as a plain text file (with 'Packet summary line' enabled) to /home/ga/Documents/captures/smtp_resolved.txt. The exported file MUST display the resolved names, not the raw IP addresses.
